scope: Independent read-only delivered-source audit with temporary copied reproducers

findings.title: 只读事务未固定隔离级别，教师库 READ COMMITTED 下主行/时间线混合版本
findings.trigger: Connection isolation READ COMMITTED; writer commits atomic owner+timeline update after owner SELECT but before ownerEvents SELECT.
findings.observed: Real isolated MySQL: response master version=0, timeline version=1. Writer committed both in one transaction.
findings.recommendation: For multi-query read aggregates explicitly require REPEATABLE_READ (or freeze connection isolation with validation), including detail/owner/list and LocationService aggregate reads. Retain a two-connection barrier regression test under a READ COMMITTED connection baseline.

findings.title: UTF-8 BOM 配置导致三个教师脚本无法执行
findings.trigger: Valid .private/database.json/test-database.json prefixed with UTF-8 BOM U+FEFF; equivalent to Windows PowerShell 5.1 Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 output.
findings.observed: All three tools exit 1 in JSON.parse before Java/Maven spawn. Reproduced on Node 22.21.1 using synthetic non-secret files; not a Windows physical-host test.
findings.recommendation: Centralize private JSON reading, strip a single leading UTF-8 BOM before JSON.parse, validate config shape and emit sanitized errors. Document UTF-8 creation; detect unsupported UTF-16 without printing file text.

findings.title: 历史夹具单位未校验且被目录单位静默覆盖
findings.trigger: Copy valid history-cases.json; change data.unit from kW to V without modifying samples.
findings.observed: Provider starts; returns unchanged four samples under unit=kW, issues=[], so input V values are mislabeled as kW.
findings.recommendation: Validate history unit type and exact equality with device/tag catalog before accepting fixture; reject mismatch or explicitly report unit error, never relabel unchanged numeric values. Validate successful response envelope alongside metadata.

findings.title: 目录时间戳未执行统一 epoch 上限，向页面输出不可用时刻
findings.trigger: Set catalog observedAt and a device communicationTime to Long.MAX_VALUE.
findings.observed: CatalogReader accepts and exposes 9223372036854775807; QualityPolicy.time rejects same value under MAX_EPOCH=8640000000000000. Frontend timestamp contract cannot accept it.
findings.recommendation: Use the shared epoch validation for observedAt/communicationTime and reject out-of-range catalog values at startup; add boundary MAX_EPOCH/MAX_EPOCH+1 tests.

testsNote: Three focused JUnit methods intentionally assert the bad behavior to establish reproduction; test success does not mean the implementation is correct. BOM scripts reproduce pre-spawn failure independently.
